# fortune-mod 1.99.1 notices

Verbatim from the `fortune-mod-1.99.1` tarball
(<https://github.com/shlomif/fortune-mod/archive/refs/tags/fortune-mod-1.99.1.tar.gz>,
sha256 `22bfb63917192718df8929e2cb2beb5e85e7e1afbd643e6280cc138116f77a33`), so
the attribution travels with the package instead of pointing at a tarball.

- `fortune.c.license` — `fortune/fortune.c`, lines 1-37: the 4-clause BSD notice
  for fortune(6), copyright 1986, 1993 The Regents of the University of
  California, derived from software contributed to Berkeley by Ken Arnold.
  Berkeley rescinded the advertising clause for its own code in 1999, so it is
  usually quoted as BSD 3-Clause today. It covers the C program, not the
  quotations.
- `Notes` — `Notes` (NetBSD, `$NetBSD: Notes,v 1.2 1995/03/23 08:28:26 cgd Exp $`):
  the only statement upstream makes about the database, which was collected
  haphazardly, has uncheckable attributions, and is used under fair use.

The release contains no `COPYING` or `LICENSE` file, and no file under
`datfiles/` carries a notice.
